name: Touch Me Not
body:
School: abjuration; Level: bard 2, rook 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: V

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 round/level
Saving Throw: Will half; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Your body is charged with energy that harms your enemies.

You gain a +2 deflection bonus to AC, and any opponent that makes a touch attack or a grapple combat maneuver against you takes 1d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (to a maximum of +5). The opponent may make a Will save for half damage. Allies can touch you without harm. The spell has no effect on those you touch or grapple- it only harms those who actively touch or grapple you.
